findings.evidence: envelope-sync skill (C:/Users/wompu/.claude/commands/envelope-sync.md L21-29) is dry-run-by-default and gates --apply by user confirmation, designed for advisory not auto. Mass-flipping envelope.status from 'not_started' → 'completed' will break milestone-aware Stop hooks that gate on completion + any roadmap rollup that uses claimedStatus as the planner intent (e.g. PRISM-UNIFIED-ROADMAP). MILESTONE_PROGRESS.md L80 frames drift rows as 'candidates for a status update' not automatic flips.
findings.impact: Auto-flip without operator review converts planning intent to git reality, losing 'should ship' vs 'has shipped' distinction. Could mark MS0..MS3 milestones complete prematurely and silently disable downstream wiring/test gates.
findings.recommendation: Force U-DRIFT-02 through envelope-sync --dry-run + human approval. Never --apply autonomously.
